title: How Atsu became the Onryo in Ghost of Yotei
subject: atsu
description:
Would you have chosen revenge after sixteen years? 👇

How a girl left for dead at a burning ginkgo tree became the Onryo of Ezo. Spoilers for Ghost of Yotei.

scenes.text: Atsu was a child when six masked killers burned her home.
In 1587, the Yotei Six murdered her parents, and she believed her twin brother died with them.
Then they pinned her to the family ginkgo tree with her father's own sword, and left her in the flames.
Somehow, she pulled herself free and vanished.
For sixteen years she fought as a mercenary in the south, carrying a sash painted with six names.
In 1603 she came home to Ezo, and soldiers began whispering about a vengeful spirit: the Onryo.
